#051 · Mole Pokémon

Dugtrio

Ground

Kanto · Generation 1

Dugtrio is a Ground-type Mole Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 33.3 kg. It evolves from Diglett. Its highest base stat is Speed (120), with a base stat total of 425.
